narrative.overview:
The ten roadmap sites share the Akashi design system from packages/akashi. The base is monochrome. Each roadmap adds one identity colour, the language's own, and uses it in four places only: the brand chip and favicon, the hero keyword, the up-next graph node and the current-module marker.

The shell is Akashi's: Zen Kaku Gothic New for headings and the wordmark, Manrope for body and buttons, DM Mono for code. The fonts are self-hosted from @fontsource under OFL-1.1. The site loads no Google Fonts.

Akashi has no dark theme. The roadmaps author one in packages/akashi/dark.css. The first visit follows the OS. The toggle stores light or dark in localStorage.

Motion is GSAP for four moves: the route enter, the graph draw-in, result reveal and badge pop, with a counter. Everything else uses Akashi's 180ms transitions. All of it is off under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Akashi base copied verbatim from the viz design system; roadmap additions live in roadmap.css and dark.css.
One identity colour per language, in three tokens: --identity, --identity-ink, --identity-accent.
Monochrome everywhere else: links, buttons, focus, nav and badges.
Status colours (passed, in progress, failed) always carry an icon and a word.
Monaco theme rebuilt from the tokens on every theme change.

rules.name: The Four Places Rule
rules.body: The identity colour appears only on the brand chip and favicon, the hero keyword, the up-next graph node and the sidebar's current-module marker.

rules.name: The Status Is Not Colour Rule
rules.body: Every status has an icon and a word. Colour alone never carries a state.

rules.name: Six-Digit Monaco Rule
rules.body: Monaco accepts only #rrggbb. Tokens are read with getComputedStyle and normalised before the theme is defined.

dos: Do use the identity colour in the four places only.
Do keep text on --hover-fill and --mention-surface at --lead.
Do set both themes in every token block.
Do run npm run check:design after changing a colour.
donts: Don't put the identity colour on a control, link, focus ring or badge.
Don't add coloured glows or large shadows to cards.
Don't hard-code a colour in a component. Use a token.
Don't load fonts from Google Fonts.
